seed_audio_generate.selection: This tool has no per-call `model` argument. The Seed Speech adapter uses the fixed model below; this is not a ModelArk model binding.

models.name: Seed Audio 1.0
models.capabilities: Full-scene speech, music and sound generation; text, audio references or image reference; image and audio references are mutually exclusive; 1-5 independent variations.

seed_tts_generate.selection: The `model` argument accepts only `dola-seed-tts-3.0` and defaults to that ID. Supply exactly one of `text` or `ssml`. The `voice_id` is required. Use a Speaker ID for the target language from the [Seed TTS 3.0 Voice List](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplusvoice/voicelist-3-0) or an authorized cloned ID. Audio is always persisted. Optional `output_path` and `overwrite` control a local export, subject to server output-path policy. See the [official Seed TTS 3.0 HTTP streaming reference](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplusvoice/seed-tts-3-0-http-streaming).

models.name: Seed TTS 3.0
models.availability: `BYTEPLUS_SEED_SPEECH_API_KEY` required; same registration gate and `seed:audio:generate` scope as Seed Audio.
models.capabilities: Text or SSML to speech with MP3 (default), PCM, or Ogg Opus output. Supports `voice_settings`, pronunciation and replacement rules in `pronunciation_dictionary.tone`, language, subtitles, `session_id`, text normalization, Markdown filtering, and appended `silence_duration` from 0 to 30000 ms.

models.name: Seed 2.1 Turbo
models.capabilities: Images/video; 32 combined media parts; 256K context; deep thinking; text, JSON object or JSON Schema output.
